mission.title: Democratizing Career Clarity For Bharat
mission.subtitle: Why 4.5 crore Indian students need a transparent, symmetrical portal instead of commercial coaching hype.
mission.storyTitle: Riya's Story: From Varanasi to Civil Services
mission.storyP1: Riya is a bright Class 10 student from a middle-class family in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. Scoring 92% in Class 10, she was eager to serve the nation, but lacked unbiased guidance on whether Arts or Science would keep UPSC and State Services doors open.
mission.storyP2: Coaching agents pushed ₹5,00,000 multi-year coaching packages, claiming government exams are impossible without expensive private courses. No one revealed that NCERTs, state universities, and zero-cost public libraries form the true backbone of civil service preparation.
mission.storyP3: PathFinder India was built to eliminate this information asymmetry — a strictly un-sponsored, mathematically verified portal showing every Indian student their genuine, open pathways.

pillars.p1Desc: 100% un-sponsored. We never promote private coaching centers or sell student leads.
pillars.p2Desc: Information structured in crystal-clear bento-boxes without cognitive overload.
pillars.p3Desc: Real Uttar Pradesh and national quota breakdowns, actual exam fees, and deadlines.
pillars.p4Desc: Complete technical and conceptual precision in Hindi and regional languages.
